key_insight: An AI-assisted evaluation pipeline improves the reliability of judging research-level mathematical proofs across natural language, CAS code, and Lean formalizations.
engineering_relevance: Multi-format proof evaluation offers a methodology for checking AI-generated scientific reasoning and supporting code at scale.
method: Analyze Ramanujan Challenge submissions on research-level number theory problems.
Assess semantic and logical correctness across natural language proofs, CAS code, and Lean formalizations.
Compare evaluation performance with conventional one-shot LLM judgment.
evidence_signal: The pipeline reduced false-positive verdicts on natural language proofs from 23% to 6% and increased supporting-code judgment accuracy from 46% to 58%.
watch_item: Residual evaluation errors remain substantial, and the abstract does not establish generalization beyond this number theory benchmark.
paper_title: Ramanujan Challenge Results: AI-Assisted Evaluation Pipeline for Multi-Format Proofs
